extracted.name: Chocolate Fudge Banana Bread
extracted.description: Try this ooey, gooey chocolate fudge banana bread recipe that gets its moist, satisfying texture from olive oil, overripe bananas, and fudge pudding mix.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3.9 ounce) package instant chocolate fudge pudding mix
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a loaf pan.

Combine flour, sugar, pudding mix, salt, and baking powder in a bowl; stir in bananas, 3/4 cup chocolate chips, eggs, and oil. Pour batter into the prepared pan; sprinkle remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips on top.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, about 1 hour 20 minutes.
